new: On 19 August 2026 NOAA published the application for public comment, which closed on 19 October, and no permit had been issued. The authority opened an inquiry into NORI and TOML. The two companies took it to the Seabed Disputes Chamber of the international law of the sea tribunal on 5 June 2026. On 18 July the chamber unanimously ordered the authority to respect due process in the inquiry, without suspending it, and the merits remain undecided. On 20 July the authority's council extended NORI's contract to 21 July 2031. TOML's contract runs to 11 January 2027, and its extension request was pending.
